description: This file contains tests for pairing file helper functions, including path resolution, pruning expired entries, and reconciling pairing requests, utilizing the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: resolvePairingPaths
methods.description: Resolves file paths for pairing related files based on a base directory and a subdirectory name.

methods.name: pruneExpiredPending
methods.description: Removes entries from pending object that are older than a specified TTL.

methods.name: reconcilePendingPairingRequests
methods.description: Updates pending pairing requests by merging incoming requests and optionally refreshing existing ones.

ctags.name: existing
ctags.pattern: /^    const existing = { requestId: "req-1", deviceId: "device-1", ts: 1, version: 1 };$/
